ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast; the surface is predominantly comprised of low-intensity pixels with widely dispersed high-intensity micro-points.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central notch with an obtuse internal angle and minimal vertical pixel-depth relative to the total horizontal span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge margin, characterized by 2-5 pixel vertical variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly horizontal convex trajectory extending from the median notch to the tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed clusters of high-contrast white pixels (approximately 2-5 pixels in diameter) scattered across the low-intensity fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive and uniform white stippling pattern across the entire visible surface, representing dense localized scarring or attachment marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high aspect ratio of the fluke lobes and visible vertical seam artifacts resulting from panoramic image stitching.
